name: conexus-tool-spill
description: Opt-in: main-session tool results over a size limit are written to a file; the model sees the head and the path, so a big read costs a few KB of context instead of all of it.

limit.title: Spill limit (bytes)
limit.description: A main-session tool result larger than this many bytes is cut. Results at or under it pass unchanged.

head.title: Head kept (bytes)
head.description: How many bytes of a cut result the model still sees, trimmed back to a line end. Capped at the spill limit.
